title: Frontend: Toggle password
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Toggle password. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. A controlled input labelled Password starts as type=password. A type=button Show password control toggles type text/password and changes its name to Hide password, retaining the password value. It must not submit the form.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Keep visibility as a boolean independent of the controlled password string.
alternativeApproaches: Support press-and-hold reveal with pointer cancellation while retaining a keyboard-accessible alternative.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Empty value; toggling after typing; form does not submit.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
